_about: 가상 내부자료에 심는 사실 원장. 모두 허구이며 모델이 알 수 없는 세부 사항. 공개 사실과 충돌하지 않도록 설계. 2023-10 ~ 2024-12 시점. contradicts 쌍은 Critic이 잡아야 할 모순. not_before/not_after: 그 사실이 문서에 등장할 수 있는 날짜 창(시점 정합성). 2026-11-01: 원장 작성자가 2025 공식 로드맵을 알고 있어 일부 사실(post_cutoff_leak 표시 7건)에 기준일 이후 정보가 반영됨 → 사전 예측 평가 시 가상 자료 제외 또는 이 사실 제외. 2026-11-01 수정: post_cutoff_leak 7건을 기준일 이전 정보만으로 다시 씀(원문은 replaced_text_2026_11_01), 해당 가상 문서 재생성.

facts.text: Project Lighthouse targets a remote ion-ion entanglement rate of 1,000 per second by end of 2025 for the photonic interconnect.
As of Q2 2024 the measured remote entanglement rate on the Lighthouse testbed is about 12 per second.
In September 2024 the hardware council selected barium-137 over ytterbium-171 for the Tempo successor (internal name Forte-N), because visible-wavelength lasers make integrated photonics feasible.
Open question in the Q3 2024 technology assessment: keep free-space laser beam delivery for the next system generation, or move to integrated photonic beam delivery on the trap chip.
facts.replaced_text_2026_11_01: Open question in the Q3 2024 technology assessment: build electronic (RF/microwave) gate control in-house, or obtain it through licensing or acquisition.
facts.leak_fixed: 전자식 제어 확보를 인수로 → 2025 Oxford Ionics 인수

facts.text: Engineering estimates integrated photonic beam delivery would take about three years to reach production readiness, versus about one year to upgrade the existing acousto-optic modulator system.
facts.replaced_text_2026_11_01: Engineering estimates an in-house electronic-control program would take at least four years, whereas an acquisition path could deliver it in roughly eighteen months.

facts.text: The Harbor 2D surface-trap prototype chip reached a fabrication yield of 23% at the external foundry in Q1 2024.
The Harbor chip yield target is 60% by Q2 2025.
The November 2024 R&D review revised the Harbor chip yield target down to 45%, with the date pushed to Q4 2025.
The cryogen-free extreme-high-vacuum chamber bake-out time was cut from 14 days to 5 days in May 2024.
The FPGA real-time error decoder for Tempo-class systems has a latency target below 1 microsecond for 2025.
Northfield Pharma requires two-qubit gate fidelity of at least 99.9% and at least 60 algorithmic qubits for its drug-binding simulation pilot in the second half of 2025.
The AFRL program office requires an on-premise system that can run fully air-gapped and fits within two standard racks.
The AWS Braket team asked for job queue latency under 10 minutes for Forte Enterprise workloads.
An automotive customer expects battery-chemistry simulations needing more than 80 qubits by 2026.
A financial-services customer wants portfolio optimization at 120 qubits; internal consensus is that this scale requires error-corrected logical qubits rather than raw physical qubits.

A strategy memo argues that NIST's finalization of post-quantum cryptography standards in August 2024 will shift enterprise security budgets, creating an opening for a bundled quantum-networking and QKD offer.
Legal flagged that the BIS September 2024 interim rule on quantum items will require export licenses for shipping Forte-class systems to several Asia-Pacific partners.
Sales flagged three lost deals in 2024 where the customer cited a competitor's 56-qubit system, raising pressure on raw qubit count as a buying criterion.

facts.node_hint: shift from AQ to logical-qubit metrics
facts.text: Marketing proposed keeping #AQ as the headline performance metric through 2025 and publishing the full #AQ benchmark circuits and raw results for every new system.
facts.replaced_text_2026_11_01: Marketing proposed retiring the #AQ metric after the AQ 64 milestone and moving to physical and logical qubit counts in 2025, anticipating that the industry will converge on logical-qubit metrics.

facts.text: The first customer shipment of Tempo is scheduled for Q1 2025.
The first Tempo customer shipment has slipped to Q2 2025 because of a laser subsystem supplier delay.
A 'quantum networking starter kit' product combining QKD hardware and an ion-photon entanglement node is targeted for 2026.
facts.replaced_text_2026_11_01: A 'quantum networking starter kit' product combining QKD hardware and a quantum memory node is targeted for 2026.

facts.text: The internal estimate for the on-premise enterprise quantum computing market is $1.2 billion by 2028.
The internal bookings target for fiscal 2025 is $75 million to $95 million.
Helion Photonics quotes a 26-week lead time for the 1550 nm to visible frequency converters used in the interconnect.
Phase 2 of the Seattle manufacturing facility, an ISO 6 cleanroom, is targeted for commissioning in Q3 2025.
The 2025 hiring plan calls for 40 additional control-electronics engineers.
The DARPA Quantum Benchmarking Initiative Stage A application was submitted in August 2024; the internal estimate of award probability is 60%.
An export license application for the Forte system destined for KISTI in Korea was filed in September 2024.
Risk register: single-source dependency on one ultra-high-vacuum chamber vendor.
Customers do not accept any standard benchmark beyond #AQ, which blocks apples-to-apples comparison in procurement.
Planning assumes error-corrected logical qubits will use 16:1 to 32:1 encodings, consistent with the 2020 public roadmap.
facts.replaced_text_2026_11_01: Planning assumes a physical-to-logical qubit ratio of about 12.5 to 1 using QLDPC codes by 2027.

facts.text: Risk register: attrition of key laser scientists during post-acquisition integration.
Support for the 11-qubit Harmony system will be wound down by the end of 2024 to free engineering capacity.
A letter of intent with Nordic Quantum Fabrication for a second source of trap chips was signed in November 2024.
The Q4 2024 vendor screening shortlisted three suppliers of multi-channel acousto-optic modulators, including a German supplier referred to as Vendor B.
facts.replaced_text_2026_11_01: The Q4 2024 screening shortlisted three acquisition candidates for electronic qubit control, including a UK-based startup referred to as Candidate B.
facts.leak_fixed: 영국 스타트업 인수 후보 → Oxford Ionics

facts.text: An Interconnect Tiger Team of eight full-time engineers will be formed in Q4 2024, owned by the VP of Hardware.
Action: publish the #AQ 36 benchmark methodology and raw data for Forte Enterprise by Q1 2025 to answer customer questions about reproducibility.
facts.replaced_text_2026_11_01: Action: engage NIST on an #AQ-to-logical-qubit benchmark crosswalk white paper by Q1 2025.

facts.text: Forte Enterprise on-premise specification: two 19-inch racks, about 3 kW power, no cryogenics, 36 algorithmic qubits.
Tempo target specification: 64 algorithmic qubits, 99.9% two-qubit fidelity, about 100 physical qubits.
A draft customer deck claims a demonstrated remote entanglement rate of 100 per second; engineering flagged this as unsupported by current testbed data.
Open question: build an in-house trap-chip foundry or stay fabless with two external sources.
